name: Steris Harms
summary: Waxillium's fiancée and later wife, a woman whose extreme organization, list-making, and social awkwardness initially make her seem cold and unapproachable. Beneath her meticulous exterior lies a fiercely brave and resourceful woman who proves invaluable on Wax's adventures: her countless contingency plans, legal knowledge, and unexpected physical courage save the day more than once. Her relationship with Wax grows from an arranged engagement into a genuine partnership, and her journey from a socially anxious noblewoman to a confident leader is one of the most quietly powerful arcs in the Wax and Wayne series.
